utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’m in—what time should I show up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably be a little late, but I can be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — I’ll plan on 10 and get things started until you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—just tell me what needs fixing and when you want to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the list first so I don’t miss anything. Can you tell me which repairs are most urgent and what day you’re free to start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The urgent ones are anything leaking, broken, or unsafe. I’m free to start on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we’re still short on for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d really help. I’m a bit scattered, so if you spot anything we’re missing, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll make a quick list and let you know if we’re short on anything important.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. Do you know what they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet, but I think they still need volunteers to sort donations and handle drop-off timing. I’d want to double-check the details before promising anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I can help sort donations if they still need people. Let me know once you’ve checked the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, are we still on for the repair drive today? I can bring a toolbox if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I think so—thanks, that’d help a lot. I’m still catching up on the details, but I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the toolbox and head over then. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing in all sorts of broken gadgets and tools—sounds like a good turnout already.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, seems like folks are really showing up with all kinds of fix-it projects. I’ve got a few tools set aside if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Gus—people will be glad to know you’re there to help. I’ll spread the word and send anyone I see your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve already been telling folks about the repair drive—happy to pass it along if you want!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—could you tell me where the repair drive is happening and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s over at the community hall on Maple Street, and it starts at 6 this evening. I’ll keep spreading the word too!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re handling it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ve got it covered this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m getting the repair drive organized now—want to help me make a quick list of what the neighbors need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help—just keep it quick and I’ll jot down the main things folks need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo—let’s start with the biggest urgent repairs and then add anything else folks mention. I’ll keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll let folks know we’re getting it organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple—just tell people what to bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone what to bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I almost spaced on that. What still needs doing, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly sorting donations and checking what still needs fixing. I can help, just tell me where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help—could you start by sorting the donations? I’ll check the broken stuff and we can compare notes after.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good idea — I’m happy to help connect people if you need me to spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — that’d be really helpful. I’ll let you know what I need shared.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — just send me the details, and I’ll help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive—want me to invite a few more neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great—thanks. I’ll probably show up a bit late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll get the word out and make sure folks know you’re coming later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly sorting donations and helping carry things in. If you can come by at 10, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do 10 and help sort and carry things. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times—what repair drive details do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye—that’d help a lot. Can you tell me which pickup windows are busiest and which days you’re usually available?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The busiest pickup window is usually 3:00 to 3:30, and I’m most available after 4 on weekdays. I can also do a bit more on Wednesdays and weekends.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds great — I can help spread the word and bring folks together for it. What time should I tell people to come by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s say 10 in the morning — that should give everyone a good start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, 10 a.m. it is — I’ll let people know. Hopefully we can get a solid little team together for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help out with the repair drive—if folks need tools, I can lend a hand. Just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m just trying to keep track of what’s needed and who’s bringing what, so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—if you make a list, I can check what tools I’ve got and bring anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track it down—do you know where the repair drive was last seen?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I last saw the repair drive near the community shed after the meeting, but I’ll check with a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s a good lead—I’ll check the area by the community shed too. If anyone mentions it, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, what exactly do you need repaired for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to check the drive itself first, then I can tell you exactly what needs fixing. If you have a moment, I can describe the problem I’m seeing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, go ahead—what problem are you seeing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—could you help gather any extra screws, nails, and a couple of working flashlights? That’d make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll check around for screws, nails, and a couple of working flashlights and bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m still catching up on the details. What do folks need most?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mostly tools and spare parts, I think — I’m not totally up to speed either. If you’ve got any, they’d probably be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I might have a couple of spare tools I can check for. I’ll ask around too and see what else people are short on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, right — the repair drive. Can you confirm what time it starts and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — it starts at 10 this Saturday, and we’re meeting by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just to confirm: 10 this Saturday by the community center entrance, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard folks are gathering tools and parts for the repair drive—seems like a good turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I’m glad people are pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s nice to see the neighborhood pulling together. I’m going to stop by and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’d be happy to help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren—could you bring a Phillips screwdriver and the spare fuses if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll grab a Phillips screwdriver and check for the spare fuses before I head over.
